name: Lobed Circular Mirror with Decoration of Two Phoenixes and Two Lotus Plants
summary: This eight-lobed, circular mirror has a narrow raised outer rim that is completely unembellished.  This gives way to a wide inner decorative border that's slightly sunken and embellished with relief-decoration of discrete lotus buds, leaves, and blossoms within the center of each lobe.  The main circular field of decoration is relatively wide.
